# State Contradictor

## Purpose

Maintains the log using references/state-template.md.

## Workflow

1. Follow the template.

## Output Format

A log entry rendered exactly as the template in Supporting Files shows.

## Gotchas

- Editing old entries in the append-only log file rewrites the record;
  describe the correction in a new entry instead.
